result.summary: Mechanically adds `#include <util/check.h>` and removes `#include <cassert>` across unit test, fuzz, and benchmark files invoking `assert` or `Assert`. Updates the scripted-diff lint runner to allow `clang-format` so that headers can be automatically formatted and sorted.
result.problem: Test code frequently relies on transitive includes or standard `<cassert>`, leading to confusion over whether `NDEBUG` can disable assertions. Furthermore, compiling without assertions in `util/check.h` causes build failures in files missing the include, and missing direct includes hinders running Include-What-You-Use (IWYU) tooling.
evidence: Commit 3c4faee67c: "The project has a compile error when compiled without assertions in util/check.h. Thus, util/check.h should be included for all assertions."

PR description: "In test code, `assert` is used. This is perfectly fine, but sometimes confusion arises, when it is unclear whether `NDEBUG` can disable the assertions, or whether to use `assert` or `Assert`. Avoid that confusion in test code with a scripted replacement to add the util/check.h include. The changes here will also make it easier to run IWYU."
result.scope_notes: A mechanical scripted-diff across 154 test files, accompanied by a small change to `ci/lint/01_install.sh` to allow `clang-format` execution during scripted-diff verification.
result.changed_since_previous: Rebased with no structural changes to the commit stack or approach.
result.card: Adds explicit `#include <util/check.h>` and drops `<cassert>` across unit test, benchmark, and fuzz files via a scripted-diff. This prevents compile errors when compiling without assertions in `util/check.h`, clarifies that assertions will not be stripped by `NDEBUG`, and facilitates automated IWYU analysis. It also permits `clang-format` inside CI scripted-diff checks to sort modified include blocks.

risk.why: Touches only test code headers and CI lint tooling; a bug would only cause test compilation or lint failures.
